diagnosis: Attention plus the exact diagnostic source MLP and the stored rank768 basis oracle both clear the 0.98 cosine gate. Both learned coefficient decoders fail. The measured layer2 bottleneck is out-of-sample coefficient generalization, not attention capacity, basis capacity, routing accuracy, or metric corruption.
decision: Authorize exactly one analytic source-aligned coefficient repair: retain the same trained attention, basis rank, sparse width, selected source neurons, data, seed, ridge, routes, and gates; set the sparse coefficient maps from the selected source down-projection columns projected into the fixed basis, then solve the full-feature linear map only for the remaining coefficient residual and rescreen layer2.
claim_boundary: Read-only layer2 bottleneck diagnosis only; no repaired layer, assembled artifact, English quality, runtime, Phase 3 certificate, or superiority claim.
